title: Baldwin Biography Becomes the Basis for a Planned Feature Film
summary:
A biography gathers a life into a book. A film adaptation then faces another task: turning that written account into a screen story. Higher Ground and Anonymous Content have announced a project based on Baldwin: A Love Story, Nicholas Boggs's biography of writer and activist James Baldwin.

Anonymous Content has made a deal to option the book, securing rights for a possible adaptation. It has also made a deal for Boggs and novelist Marlon James to adapt the work for the screen. Both writers will serve as executive producers as well.

The source describes a feature film in development, rather than a finished movie. It does not announce a cast, director or release date. The new development is the production and adaptation agreement, with a researched biography supplying the starting material.

Boggs's book drew on newly uncovered archival material and fresh reporting. Archival material means records preserved from the past. The biography examines Baldwin's personal and artistic relationships, showing the people connected with his life and work.

They include Beauford Delaney, a Black American painter who was Baldwin's mentor; Swiss painter Lucien Happersberger; Turkish actor Engin Cezzar; and French artist Yoran Cazac. The book's focus on these relationships provides another way into the life of a writer, beyond a list of published works.

Higher Ground is the media company founded by Barack and Michelle Obama. The former president has expressed admiration for Baldwin's writing and featured The Fire Next Time on his podcast A Great Book with Barack Obama.

At Anonymous Content, Darren Walker recently became president and chief executive. He announced the project at the Bloomberg Screentime conference on Thursday. Walker and David Levine are producers for Anonymous Content, with Anikah McLaren for Higher Ground and Howard Gertler also producing.

Baldwin's life and legacy have previously been explored in a documentary. This planned feature begins with a different source: Boggs's biography. The announcement connects archival research, contemporary writers and film producers in a new adaptation of a life story.
why_it_matters: The announcement shows how archival research and a written life story can lead to a screen adaptation, with different people taking writing and production roles.
